collection: bf16 policy under the strict deterministic settings (scripts/launch_strict.py); every executed call is stored with its observation, proprioception, fp32 noise, reference action, masks, control frequency and policy seed. No attribution is computed during collection. No success- or norm-based selection.
question: Must Fix 2, 3, 5 and 6 of the NHSJS review: a prospective record of the public RDT-170M checkpoint with every input preserved; a policy that completes PickCube (the authors' RDT-1B checkpoint) and a second task (StackCube); several attribution methods under Q and N with random-order and fixed-order controls; and the integration and precision comparison on contexts that still exist.
sampling: P: 60 episodes (120 contexts). B1: 40 episodes (80 contexts). S: 30 episodes (60 contexts). Sizes were fixed from the smoke-run timings and the $200 cap before any production context existed; they are engineering and budget choices, not power calculations.
seeds: Simulator and policy-noise blocks are new and disjoint from Month 8 (920100-921299), the smoke run (950100-950699) and the historical seeds (42, 142, 242 and their offsets).
selection: Two calls per episode drawn uniformly from the executed calls by the locked uniform_executed_calls_v1 rule after the episode ends; all executed calls stay stored. The call cap (26) never binds because 400 steps take 25 calls, so every episode ends by success, failure or the 400-step limit.
stopping_rule: Collect every declared episode. No interim look at attributions or responses. An infrastructure failure resumes the same stratum with --resume on the same configuration; failed attempts stay in the run.
